details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:192-197 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The probe subprocess does not unset a pre-existing `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` before setting it from the token file.
  WHY: A stale runner token could cause the Haiku probe to authenticate as another account and produce a stale utilization reading that corrupts account ordering.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:253 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The account-attempt loop exports the token read from the file without masking it again.
  WHY: If `set -x` or `bash -x` is enabled, the unmasked token could be written to stderr on each account attempt.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:419-421 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The failing-check capture filter omits `action_required` and `startup_failure` conclusions.
  WHY: Those checks are excluded from fingerprint evidence, potentially causing distinct failures to share a fingerprint and consume judge budget unnecessarily.
- scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py:152-157 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Upstream response headers are forwarded without value-length validation.
  WHY: An abnormally large or malformed upstream header could cause excessive memory allocation or crash the bridge process.
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:215-220 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The space-delimited account membership pattern can match an account name that is a substring of another account name.
  WHY: An account named `FOO` could match `FOOBAR` in the ordered list, although the reviewer describes this as a theoretical edge case.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:line 116 (ROLES tuple), line 128 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `LOG_AUDIT` is not included in `UTILITY_ROLES`, so audit runs use Opus 5.5 instead of Sonnet 5.5.
  WHY: Claude audit runs may cost more and exhaust the pool budget faster than intended.
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge_dispatch.yml:27-28 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: OIDC token request variables remain available to the codex fallback path when the workflow requests `id-token: write`.
  WHY: A step on a codex-only run could request a JWT for the claude-pool-broker audience even though Claude is not used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
